d:
The Badshah who created the blueprint for Bhangra pop doles out bounty of enjoyment with his ‘Mojaan Laen Do’. The album is a nine-track jewel by the Pasha of Pop Daler Mehndi and straight from his heart.
He introduces a new genre of folk music ‘Rababi’ – a revival of a traditional form of singing with a mix of Sufi and Arabic rhythms. This is his eighth album and with its combustible union of lyrics and melody and beat, Mojaan Laen Do showcases his musical prowess as he manages to stay miles ahead continually pushing the limit of Indi pop acceptability.
